audit.summary: The published gradient can increase its stated objective; the stability proof does not justify an iteration-independent bound; the printed reward reverses its released implementation; the released RL path fails its perturbation cap; and two metric pairs are impossible under the stated definitions.
limitations: No author code, datasets, weights or original experiments were executed.
Repository bytes are a pinned later public commit, not established experiment provenance.
Separate OpenReview supplement access was blocked in source preparation; embedded appendices were available.

Theorem 6.3's literal all-real-weights eigengap premise is infeasible; the stability counterexample is explicitly to the meaningful simplex/squared-mixture interpretation, not a false claim to satisfy that literal premise.
No full benchmark rerun or exhaustive audit of all clustering baselines; later errata search limited to publisher and repository landing pages.
The original report's complete scope, counterevidence and unresolved questions are retained below.
This import checks publication format and identity; it does not repeat scientific review.
Independent human scientific review is pending; author adoption has not been requested.

assumptions: Two unit-diagonal PSD 2x2 kernels; K=1; simplex gamma; /N normalization; nonzero uniform feasible eigengap.
Counterexample explicitly uses the natural feasible-simplex and squared-mixture reading; literal all-real gamma premise is impossible at zero.
Two orthonormal-column N=4,K=2 representations and original two-cluster co-occurrence; no full constrained-data attack asserted.
Single environment, reset cumulative noise, positive threshold, sampled action with norm above radius; Gaussian policy has full support.
Same samples/predictions or paired-run averages; one-to-one mapped accuracy and per-cluster majority purity.
